title: H265b: Drift-Regime Value + Short-Term Reversal (paper's actual signals)
rationale: H265 CONFIRMED using momentum inside drift regime (OOS Sharpe 2.947), but the arXiv:2511.12490 paper's actual signals are VALUE + SHORT-TERM REVERSAL, not momentum — H265 inadvertently tested a different signal. H265b should replicate the paper's intended design: stock eligible if fraction positive days in trailing 63 days > 0.60, then rank eligible stocks by value (B/P) and short-term reversal (negative 1-month return). Important: H265's extraordinary Sharpe is almost certainly inflated by survivorship bias (fixed 2025-known universe). H265b must use a properly constructed rolling universe (e.g. S&P 500 constituents history or point-in-time Russell 1000 list). If H265b survives survivorship-bias correction AND tests the paper's intended signals, it becomes a much stronger production candidate.
